Coram : ASHOK BHUSHAN*, R. SUBHASH REDDY
Foreign Exchange Regulation Act, 1973: ss.8(3), 8(4), 50, 51 and 68 – Show cause notice for initiation for proceedings u/s. 51 against Company and its Directors for contravention of ss. 8(3) r/w 8(4) and 68 – Reply by the Company – Initiation of proceedings – Appellant (one a part-time, non-executive Director and was not responsible for the conduct of business of the Company at the relevant time – Penalty imposed by Enforcement Directorate – Appeal before Appellate Tribunal for Foreign Exchange dismissed – High Court also dismissed the appeal
Decision Date : 27-07-2020 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 2463/2014 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
